title: POWERFUL MORNING PRAYER TO COMMAND THE NEW DAY
text: Hallelujah. Hallelujah. Hallelujah. Oh, we worship you this morning. We worship you ancient of days. We worship you the one who sits above the circle of the earth. The one who calls those things that be not as though they were. We worship you. We give you praise. We give you adoration. There is none like you, Father. There is none like you. Baruch Hashem Adonai. Baruch Hashem Adonai. We bless your name. We bless your name. We bless your mighty name. Before I say a word, before a single scripture I want you to lift your voice wherever you are in your room, in your car, on your way to work. Wherever you are hearing my voice, just begin to worship the Lord. Not a casual worship, not a routine worship. I mean a worship that comes from the depth of your belly, from the core of your spirit. Because what God is about to release in the next few moments is not ordinary. This is not a motivational speech. This is not just another morning prayer. Something is about to shift in the realm of the spirit. And the instrument God will use is your voice, your faith, and the word that will come forth now. Oh, shabababababa. Rabababababa shandai. Kolokoloshai. We worship you, Lord. We worship [music] you. Now, listen to me. Before we go further, I need you to do something. Share this message. Forward it to someone. Send it to that group. Send it to that friend. Send it to that family member. You may not know what they are going through. You may not know the battle they face last night. You may not know the assignment of darkness that was released against their life at midnight. But when this word reaches them, chains will break. Covenants will scatter. Altars will catch fire. Be an instrument. God is counting on you to be a distributor of grace this morning. Do it now. Share it now. Don't wait until the end. Now, open your spirit. Receive this. The Bible says in Lamentations chapter 3 verses 22 to 23, "It is of the Lord's mercies that we are not consumed because his compassions fail not. They are new every morning. Great is thy faithfulness." Catch this. Every morning is a prophetic reset. Every morning is a mercy distribution. Every morning heaven opens a new file for your life. The question is who is commanding that file? Who is writing the narrative of your day? Is it the voice of God or is it the voice of your environment? Is it the decree of the Most High or is it the programming of the enemy done at midnight while you were asleep? >> [music] >> Because listen carefully beloved, there are dimensions to the morning that most believers do not understand. The morning is not just a time on the clock. The morning is a spiritual gateway. It is a judicial session. The psalmist understood this. David understood this. That's why he said in Psalm 5 verses 3, "My voice shall thou hear in the morning oh Lord, in the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee and will look up." David didn't just pray in the morning because it was convenient. David prayed in the morning because he understood that the morning is a courtroom. The morning is where decrees are ratified. The morning is where destinies are either released or locked. And if you are silent in the morning, something else will speak. If your voice is not heard in the courts of heaven at dawn, another voice from an altar, from a covenant, from an ancestral pattern, that voice will fill the void. This is why the enemy fights your morning. Have you noticed? The mornings you are supposed to pray the most are the mornings you feel the heaviest. The mornings that carry the greatest prophetic significance are the mornings where your body feels like lead, where confusion clouds your mind, [music] where you wake up already tired even though you slept. That is not biology. That is strategy from the pit of hell. The enemy knows that if you ever take authority over your morning, his agenda for your day collapses. And thus sayeth the spirit of God this morning, I am giving you back authority over your mornings. I am restoring the scepter of dominion to your hand. You will not be a passive observer of your days anymore. You will command your morning and it will obey you. Turn with me to Job chapter 38 verses 12 to 13. God himself, God himself asked Job this question. He said, "Has thou commanded the morning since thy days and caused the day spring to know his place that it might take hold of the ends of the earth that the wicked might be shaken out of it?" Do you see what is hidden in that verse? God is revealing that when you command the morning, the wicked are shaken out of your day. The wicked are shaken out of your territory. Witchcraft assignments, monitoring spirits, household wickedness, envoys of darkness sent on assignment against your life, when you rise and take authority over the morning, they are displaced. [music] They lose their footing. They lose their jurisdiction. And I want to prophesy to someone hearing my voice. The reason certain patterns have repeated in your life, the same disappointment, the same near success syndrome, the same unexplainable failure at the edge of breakthrough is because your mornings have been hijacked. The enemy has [music] been programming your days before you wake up. But today, right now, that cycle is breaking. The programming is being deleted. The altar is catching fire. And from this day forward, you will be the [music] one who commands your morning. Shandai robokoloshai robamashandai. Now, hear me. There's something else the spirit of God is laying on my heart. Turn to Genesis chapter 1 verse 3. The Bible says, "And God said, let there be light, and there was light." The first thing God did in the midst of chaos, in the midst of darkness, in the midst of a world that was without form and void, the first thing God did was speak. He didn't analyze. He didn't complain. He didn't consult with the darkness. He spoke. He released words. And the moment words came forth from the throne of his authority, creation responded. Light separated from darkness. Order emerged from chaos. And this is the same model for your morning. When you wake up, you are not to consult with your feelings. You are not to consult with your bank account. You are not to consult with the news. You are not to consult with yesterday's failure. You are to open your mouth and speak with the same authority that God invested in you when he breathed into your nostrils and you became a living soul. Speak to your day. Speak to your week. Speak to this month. Speak to the atmosphere around your life. Command the morning, and the day spring will know its place. Because the truth is, beloved, and this is where I need you to pay very close attention, your voice is a weapon. Your voice is not just sound. Your voice carries spiritual frequency. When a child of God, washed by the blood, filled with the Holy Ghost, carrying the authority of the name of Jesus, when that person speaks, things move in the heavens, angels take instructions, demons flee, doors open, barriers collapse, chains shatter. Your voice. That is why the devil fights your prayer life. He doesn't fight your career. He doesn't fight your education. He fights your prayer life because he knows that a praying believer is a dangerous believer. A believer who knows how to open their mouth in the place of prayer and command the morning, that believer is ungovernable by darkness.
